response.sql: WITH tel AS (SELECT s.telescref, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS tavg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY s.telescref, t.equipstatus), st AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(tavg) AS savg FROM tel WHERE tavg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean1 FROM st), k1 AS (SELECT st.equipstatus, st.savg, m1.mean1 FROM st, m1 WHERE st.savg > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.equipstatus, k1.savg, k1.mean1, m2.mean2 FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.savg > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(savg) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(savg - mean1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(savg - mean2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2
